status.role: source observation status; optional quality stratification only

transmitter_baud.prohibited_use: May not be multiplied by duration or otherwise interpreted as usable cryptographic recovery payload throughput.

telemetry_values.role: not part of Study 8E primary contact-timing endpoint

throughput_latency_and_dish_metrics.role: general LEO network sensitivity layer only

derived_extension_quantities.observation_opportunity_duration_seconds: end - start for valid SatNOGS observation records; treated as observation-opportunity timing only
derived_extension_quantities.inter_opportunity_gap_seconds: next_start - current_end after within-trace union of overlapping/abutting observation-opportunity windows
derived_extension_quantities.hypothetical_uniform_effective_payload_r: extension-model constant net payload rate available only inside accepted observation-opportunity windows; solved as a threshold rather than inferred from transmitter metadata or claimed as measured capacity
derived_extension_quantities.minimum_uniform_effective_payload_rate_b: lowest finite rate at which the extension transition runner reaches TRUST_RESTORED strictly before the extension horizon under the frozen trace and condition

prohibited_inferences: logical Study 8 slots to physical seconds
transmitter baud to effective payload throughput
observation existence to bidirectional command availability
TLE epoch to cryptographic epoch validity
satellite or station identity to cryptographic trust
